components.title: AirPlay network test service
components.description: For the app AirPlay Test: the network test, and the AirPlay receiver (UxPlay's protocol on the head unit): the iPhone's screen mirroring decoded on the GPU into mgu-render's frame file, shown by the app while parked, and its sound into SmartXbar's CarLife input. Opens the firewall for its ports only while a test runs.
components.author: aurelmarius

components.title: AirPlay Test
components.description: AirPlay receiver for the head unit: the iPhone's screen mirroring on the centre screen while parked, with its sound on the car's speakers. Also the network test. Needs the AirPlay test service.
